rationales.authenticity: Valerian and chamomile are period-appropriate remedies; syntax and tone fit 1820 rural Ireland well, though 'weary thing' is slightly general.
rationales.character: Brigid's warm, practical midwife voice comes through; offering tea and probing for underlying causes fits her role perfectly.
rationales.craft: Three well-balanced sentences with action beats; coherent and evocative without excess.
rationales.language: Clear English with excellent rhythm and diction; no errors or anachronisms.
rationales.responsiveness: Directly addresses the sleep troubles and dreams, offers remedy and follow-up care.
